title: lynx variables
description: Configuration variables for lynx text-mode web browser and HTML-to-text converter.

LYNX_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install lynx. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, or 'from-source' compiles from source.

LYNX_VERSION.description: Specific version of lynx to install.

LYNX_INSTALL_DIR.description: Target directory for isolated lynx installation.

LYNX_OFFLINE.description: Flag (true/false or 1/0) indicating air-gapped offline installation mode for lynx.

LYNX_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading lynx binary or archive artifacts.

LYNX_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying lynx available remote releases.
